environmentVariables.name: TILA_RUN_SOCKET
environmentVariables.description: Run-specific local broker socket provided by tila run exec; use tila mcp init to configure supported client lifecycles

environmentVariables.name: TILA_RUN_CAPABILITY
environmentVariables.description: Run-specific socket capability supplied by the helper; never put this in editor configuration

environmentVariables.name: TILA_MCP_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Optional primitive groups; defaults to six workflow tools: tila_session, tila_inspect, tila_claim, tila_publish, tila_signal, tila_close. Additional tool visibility never grants backend permissions.
